topic: Properties of Matter: Absorb, Float, Sink, Decay
key_concepts: Materials can be classified by their ability to absorb water, float or sink, and undergo d
Absorb means to take something in naturally or gradually.
Porous materials have small holes that allow air or water to pass through.
Non-porous materials do not allow water to pass through.
Cotton is porous and is a natural absorber of water.
Plastics and rubber balls are non-porous and do not absorb water.
Materials made of cloth, such as towels and rugs, absorb water.
Wood and sponge have the ability to absorb water.
Some objects float in water while others sink.
An object's shape can affect its ability to float.
Empty plastic bottles, bamboo rafts, and drinking straws float in water.
Coins, metal spoons, pebbles, and hollow blocks sink in water.
